narrative: CES40-2203A-0144 threw a DC ground fault alarm so I went out and isolated it down to CB-B09-17 where there was a home run chafed clean through against the rack upright, the insulation was worn right down on it. Repaired the run and got it resecured properly clear of the steel this time. The unit is back in service and it has held since. That is the second one like it on this block and I would say it is worth somebody walking the rest of the runs down there rather than waiting for the next one to go.
